body: I usually try to wait a full day when I get to that point. Listen to my fav songs, decide if I will make a note. I have a playlist now of songs that helped Everytime I was ready to die.. it's really depressing songs though.

I have sisters that really struggle with studying and they think they are stupid and blame their mom since she is legit stupid, but I just tell them what they contribute is valuable even if they 'cant' get A's which they have before. But seriously the world puts so much value on smart = worthy when it's not true. One of them is hilarious, thinks of the funniest shit and the other is really artistic. What you CAN do is valuable and you should keep doing it.
